ev-socio-intersectionality.title: Demarginalizing the Intersection of Race and Sex
ev-socio-intersectionality.strength: Primary text; Wikipedia article covers the concept and its development in feminist and critical race theory.

ev-socio-gender.title: Gender role
ev-socio-gender.strength: Wikipedia article on gender socialisation, roles, and Butler's performativity.

ev-anthro-malinowski.title: Argonauts of the Western Pacific
ev-anthro-malinowski.strength: Foundational ethnography; Wikipedia covers participant observation, the kula ring, and functionalism.

ev-anthro-boas.title: The Study of Geography
ev-anthro-boas.strength: Wikipedia article on Boas's historical particularism, cultural relativism, and rejection of scientific racism.

ev-anthro-levi-strauss.title: Tristes Tropiques
ev-anthro-levi-strauss.strength: Wikipedia covers structuralism, binary oppositions, myth analysis, and kinship structures.

ev-anthro-geertz.title: The Interpretation of Cultures
ev-anthro-geertz.strength: Foundational interpretive anthropology text; Wikipedia covers thick description and symbolic anthropology.

ev-anthro-kinship.title: Kinship
ev-anthro-kinship.strength: Wikipedia article on kinship systems, descent, marriage, and exchange.

ev-anthro-mauss.title: The Gift
ev-anthro-mauss.strength: Primary text; Wikipedia covers Mauss's theory of gift exchange and reciprocity.

ev-anthro-sahlins.title: Stone Age Economics
ev-anthro-sahlins.strength: Wikipedia covers Sahlins's 'original affluent society' thesis and substantivist economics.

ev-anthro-culture.title: Culture
ev-anthro-culture.strength: Wikipedia article on culture as a concept in anthropology and social science.

ev-law-hart.title: The Concept of Law
ev-law-hart.strength: Foundational legal positivism text; Wikipedia covers primary/secondary rules, the rule of recognition, and Hart-Fuller debate.

ev-law-dworkin.title: Taking Rights Seriously
ev-law-dworkin.strength: Wikipedia covers Dworkin's anti-positivism, rights as trumps, and the one right answer thesis.

ev-law-natural-law.title: Natural law
ev-law-natural-law.strength: Wikipedia article on natural law theory from Aquinas to Finnis and its relation to positivism.

ev-law-constitutional.title: Constitutional law
ev-law-constitutional.strength: Wikipedia article on constitutional law, judicial review, and fundamental rights.

ev-law-critical.title: Critical legal studies
ev-law-critical.strength: Wikipedia article on CLS, legal indeterminacy, and the critique of liberal legalism.

ev-law-habermas.title: Between Facts and Norms
ev-law-habermas.strength: Primary text on deliberative democracy and law; Wikipedia covers discourse ethics and communicative rationality.

ev-law-rawls.title: A Theory of Justice
ev-law-rawls.strength: The most important political philosophy text of the 20th century; Wikipedia covers veil of ignorance and difference principle.

ev-psych-freud.title: The Interpretation of Dreams
ev-psych-freud.strength: Wikipedia article covers psychoanalysis, unconscious, id/ego/superego, and defence mechanisms.

ev-psych-pavlov.title: Conditioned Reflexes
ev-psych-pavlov.strength: Nobel Prize 1904; Wikipedia covers classical conditioning and the conditioned reflex.

ev-psych-skinner.title: The Behavior of Organisms
ev-psych-skinner.strength: Wikipedia covers operant conditioning, reinforcement schedules, and behaviorism.

ev-psych-attachment.title: Attachment and Loss, Vol. 1
ev-psych-attachment.strength: Wikipedia article on attachment theory, Ainsworth's strange situation, and attachment styles.

ev-psych-cognitive-revolution.title: Cognitive psychology
ev-psych-cognitive-revolution.strength: Wikipedia article on the cognitive revolution, information processing model, and major contributions.

ev-psych-social-influence.title: Social psychology
ev-psych-social-influence.strength: Wikipedia article on social psychology — Milgram, Asch, Zimbardo, Festinger.

ev-psych-milgram.title: Behavioral Study of Obedience
ev-psych-milgram.strength: One of the most famous psychology experiments; Wikipedia covers the obedience findings and ethical debate.

ev-psych-maslow.title: A Theory of Human Motivation
ev-psych-maslow.strength: Wikipedia article on the hierarchy of needs; widely taught and applied despite empirical limitations.

ev-psych-big-five.title: Big Five personality traits
ev-psych-big-five.strength: Wikipedia article on OCEAN personality model; the dominant personality framework in academic psychology.

ev-psych-cognitive-dissonance.title: A Theory of Cognitive Dissonance
ev-psych-cognitive-dissonance.strength: Primary text; Wikipedia covers the concept and famous demonstrations.

ev-psych-attribution.title: Attribution (psychology)
ev-psych-attribution.strength: Wikipedia article on attribution theory, fundamental attribution error, and actor-observer bias.

ev-psych-neuroplasticity.title: Neuroplasticity
ev-psych-neuroplasticity.strength: Wikipedia article on neuroplasticity, Hebbian learning, and neural development.

ev-psych-replication.title: Estimating the Reproducibility of Psychological Science
ev-psych-replication.strength: Science 2015 replication study; Wikipedia covers the replication crisis across psychology and its causes.

ev-psych-wellbeing.title: Well-being
ev-psych-wellbeing.strength: Wikipedia article on subjective wellbeing, Diener, Seligman's PERMA model.

ev-deveco-good-economics.title: Good Economics for Hard Times
ev-deveco-good-economics.strength: Tertiary article on the 2019 book by Nobel laureates Banerjee and Duflo, applying the empirical/RCT method to migration, trade, growth, inequality and climate. The 'sticky' labour-market evidence on immigration (Card's Mariel boatlift study) and the growth-pessimism (Robert Gordon) the card names are real, documented positions.

ev-find-mariel.title: Mariel boatlift
ev-find-mariel.strength: Tertiary article documenting the 1980 arrival of ~125,000 Cubans in Miami and David Card's 1990 ILR Review study finding no significant wage hit to low-skilled locals. The George Borjas (2015) re-analysis claiming wage losses — and the Peri-Yasenov rebuttal — that the card names are real, documented positions.

ev-find-china-shock.title: China shock
ev-find-china-shock.strength: Tertiary article on Autor, Dorn & Hanson's work (AER 2013, 'The China Syndrome'; 2016 follow-ups) estimating ~1–2.4 million US manufacturing jobs lost to Chinese import competition and the slow, incomplete recovery of hit local labour markets. The automation-vs-trade debate the card names is a real ongoing dispute.

ev-find-cash-transfers.title: GiveDirectly
ev-find-cash-transfers.strength: Tertiary article on the GiveDirectly cash-transfer RCTs (e.g. Haushofer & Shapiro, QJE 2016, Kenya) showing higher assets, consumption and wellbeing with no rise in alcohol/tobacco and no work reduction — the evidence base behind the Banerjee-Hanna-Kreindler-Olken (2017) review debunking the 'lazy welfare recipient' stereotype. The Finland UBI trial caveat the card names is real.

ev-find-solow-residual.title: Solow residual
ev-find-solow-residual.strength: Tertiary article on Solow's 1957 'Technical Change and the Aggregate Production Function', which found ~7/8 of the growth in US output per man-hour (1909–1949) came from technical change, not capital deepening — the residual now called total factor productivity.

ev-find-great-contraction.title: A Monetary History of the United States
ev-find-great-contraction.strength: Tertiary article on Friedman & Schwartz (1963), documenting that the US money stock fell about a third between 1929 and 1933 amid ~9,000 bank failures, and their claim that Federal Reserve passivity turned a recession into the Great Depression.

ev-find-nogales.title: Why Nations Fail
ev-find-nogales.strength: Tertiary article on Acemoglu & Robinson's book, whose opening case contrasts Nogales, Arizona with Nogales, Sonora — one city split by a border, same geography and culture, sharply different incomes — to argue institutions, not geography, drive prosperity.

ev-find-ltcm.title: Long-Term Capital Management
ev-find-ltcm.strength: Tertiary article documenting that LTCM — with Nobel laureates Scholes and Merton on its board — used heavy leverage and option-pricing models, lost ~$4.6bn after the 1998 Russian default, and triggered a ~$3.6bn Fed-organised bank bailout. A canonical case of model/tail risk.

ev-find-pin-factory.title: Division of labour
ev-find-pin-factory.strength: Tertiary article covering Adam Smith's pin-factory illustration in The Wealth of Nations (1776): one untrained worker could scarcely make one pin a day, but ten workers splitting the job into ~18 operations made about 48,000 pins a day.

ev-find-top1.title: Income inequality in the United States
ev-find-top1.strength: Tertiary article documenting Emmanuel Saez's finding that the top 1% captured about 95% of US income gains in the first years of the post-2008 recovery (2009–2012) — a headline statistic in the inequality debate Stiglitz advances.

ev-find-lemons.title: The Market for Lemons
ev-find-lemons.strength: Tertiary article noting that Akerlof's 1970 paper — founding the economics of asymmetric information — was rejected by three journals as trivial or wrong before publication in the QJE, then became one of the most-cited economics papers and central to his 2001 Nobel.

ev-find-calculation.title: Economic calculation problem
ev-find-calculation.strength: Tertiary article on the Mises–Hayek argument that central planners cannot assemble the dispersed knowledge that market prices aggregate — Soviet Gosplan had to plan and price millions of distinct goods, a task Hayek (1945) argued is informationally impossible.

ev-find-piketty.title: Capital in the Twenty-First Century
ev-find-piketty.strength: Tertiary article on Piketty's 2013 book and its central empirical claim — when the return on capital r exceeds the growth rate g, wealth concentrates; built on a long-run dataset showing European wealth-to-income ratios returning toward Belle Époque levels. The Rognlie (housing) and data-error (FT/Giles) critiques the card names are real.

ev-find-card-krueger.title: Minimum wage
ev-find-card-krueger.strength: Tertiary article covering Card & Krueger's 1994 New Jersey vs Pennsylvania fast-food natural experiment, which found no employment fall (a slight rise) after a minimum-wage increase, and the subsequent monopsony interpretation. Card shared the 2021 Nobel partly for this work; Neumark & Wascher's contrary payroll-data study is noted.

ev-find-reinhart-rogoff.title: Growth in a Time of Debt
ev-find-reinhart-rogoff.strength: Tertiary article on Reinhart & Rogoff's 2010 paper claiming growth drops sharply above 90% debt-to-GDP, and Herndon, Ash & Pollin's 2013 replication exposing a spreadsheet error and selective data — a landmark case used in the austerity debate.

ev-find-kansas.title: Kansas experiment
ev-find-kansas.strength: Tertiary article on Governor Brownback's 2012–2017 Kansas tax cuts, which were predicted to boost growth but produced budget shortfalls and lagging growth, leading the legislature to reverse them — a real-world test of supply-side / Laffer claims.

ev-find-chetty.title: Raj Chetty
ev-find-chetty.strength: Tertiary article on Chetty's work using tens of millions of tax records: absolute mobility (children out-earning their parents) fell from ~90% for the 1940 birth cohort to ~50% for the 1980 cohort, and a child's odds of rising vary sharply by neighbourhood.

ev-find-elephant.title: Elephant curve
ev-find-elephant.strength: Tertiary article on Branko Milanovic & Christoph Lakner's global growth-incidence curve (1988–2008): large gains for the global middle (emerging-Asia) and the global top 1%, near-stagnation for the rich-world lower-middle class. The Resolution Foundation re-analysis the card notes is real.

ev-find-gatsby.title: Great Gatsby Curve
ev-find-gatsby.strength: Tertiary article on the cross-country relationship (Corak; popularised by Alan Krueger, 2012) that higher income inequality goes with lower intergenerational mobility.

ev-find-spirit-level.title: The Spirit Level (book)
ev-find-spirit-level.strength: Tertiary article on Wilkinson & Pickett (2009), reporting that more-unequal rich countries score worse on a battery of health and social outcomes. The methodological critiques (Saunders, Snowdon — reverse causation, cherry-picked countries) the card names are real.

ev-find-blanchard-multiplier.title: Fiscal multiplier
ev-find-blanchard-multiplier.strength: Tertiary article covering Blanchard & Leigh's 2013 IMF finding that real fiscal multipliers during the post-2008 austerity were far above the ~0.5 forecasters had assumed (closer to 0.9–1.7), so consolidation cut output by more than predicted.

ev-find-greek-depression.title: Greek government-debt crisis
ev-find-greek-depression.strength: Tertiary article documenting that Greek GDP fell about a quarter from 2008 and unemployment topped 27% (youth >50%) under bailout-imposed austerity — a real-world austerity outcome far worse than the troika's forecasts.

ev-find-1937.title: Recession of 1937–1938
ev-find-1937.strength: Tertiary article on the 'Roosevelt recession': premature 1937 fiscal and monetary tightening, while the US was still recovering from the Depression, sent output and employment sharply back down — the textbook case of tightening too soon.

ev-rhet-toulmin.title: Stephen Toulmin (the Toulmin model)
ev-rhet-toulmin.strength: Standard reference for the claim–grounds–warrant decomposition of an argument.

ev-rhet-impact-calculus.title: Impact calculus
ev-rhet-impact-calculus.strength: Documents how competitive debate weighs impacts by magnitude, probability and timeframe.

ev-rhet-graham-disagree.title: How to Disagree
ev-rhet-graham-disagree.strength: Widely-cited hierarchy of disagreement, from name-calling up to refuting the central point.

ev-rhet-burden.title: Burden of proof (philosophy)
ev-rhet-burden.strength: Standard account of who must establish a claim and the risk of shifting the burden.

ev-rhet-steelman.title: Principle of charity / steelmanning
ev-rhet-steelman.strength: Describes the steelman — answering the strongest version of an opponent's argument.

ev-stimmer-norms.title: The Politics of International Norms: A Rhetorical Approach
ev-stimmer-norms.strength: Sets out the norm-frame vs behavioural-claim distinction and the four 'alternate endings' of norm contestation.

ev-starbucks-float.title: Banking business? Starbucks holds over $1.8 billion in customer deposits
ev-starbucks-float.strength: Reports Starbucks' $1.872bn stored-value card liability (Q2 2024), the interest-free-loan mechanism, and breakage of ~$200m.

ev-airline-loyalty.title: Airline loyalty programs are their most valuable collateral
ev-airline-loyalty.strength: Documents 2020 loyalty-program valuations exceeding airline equity (United MileagePlus ~$22bn vs $10.6bn) and their use as loan collateral.

ev-logic-modal.title: Modal logic
ev-logic-modal.strength: Standard reference tracing C.I. Lewis and Kripke's semantics; uncontroversial history.

ev-logic-godel.title: Gödel's incompleteness theorems
ev-logic-godel.strength: Encyclopaedic account of a rigorously proven result; the mathematics is settled.

ev-logic-liar.title: Liar paradox
ev-logic-liar.strength: Well-documented history from Eubulides to Tarski; interpretation of the fix is debated, noted in the counter.

ev-logic-nonclassical.title: Non-classical logic
ev-logic-nonclassical.strength: Survey reference; the systems are formally well-defined, their philosophical status is contested.

ev-logic-toulmin.title: The Uses of Argument
ev-logic-toulmin.strength: Primary work; the model is standard in argumentation theory.

ev-logic-russell-paradox.title: Russell's paradox
ev-logic-russell-paradox.strength: Historically firm; the contradiction is a proven fact about naive comprehension.

ev-epi-virtue.title: The Raft and the Pyramid
ev-epi-virtue.strength: Primary source plus survey; framework is well-established, details debated.

ev-epi-contextualism.title: Contextualism and Knowledge Attributions
ev-epi-contextualism.strength: Primary and survey references; a live, contested position.

ev-epi-disagreement.title: Epistemology of Disagreement: The Good News
ev-epi-disagreement.strength: Primary source; an active research area with no settled consensus.

ev-epi-value-knowledge.title: Meno
ev-epi-value-knowledge.strength: Classical primary text; the modern 'value problem' framing is standard in epistemology.

ev-epi-safety-sensitivity.title: Philosophical Explanations
ev-epi-safety-sensitivity.strength: Primary source; safety vs sensitivity is a well-mapped debate.

ev-epi-epistemic-injustice.title: Epistemic Injustice: Power and the Ethics of Knowing
ev-epi-epistemic-injustice.strength: Primary source; concept is influential and widely adopted.

ev-epi-criterion.title: The Problem of the Criterion
ev-epi-criterion.strength: Primary source; the ancient pedigree via Sextus is well documented.
